manifests.title: Readiness strand map
manifests.description: Depict the foundation problem exactly: A learner solves every linear equation but cancels terms illegally in rational expressions. Show the quantities, axes, intervals, or algebraic objects needed to reach this conclusion: Mark equation solving ready and route only the rational-expression strand to repair.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Use diagnostic evidence to identify which prerequisite strands are secure and which require targeted repair.

manifests.title: Evidence-to-repair flow
manifests.description: Visualize the mechanism explicitly: Attempt each strand independently, compare reasoning as well as answers, route missed skills to a focused repair page, and use a different return check to confirm transfer. The figure must show intermediate states or mappings, not merely the final formula.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Use diagnostic evidence to identify which prerequisite strands are secure and which require targeted repair.

manifests.title: Same score, different needs

manifests.title: Equation-family decision map
manifests.description: Depict the foundation problem exactly: Solve sqrt(x+1)=x-1. Show the quantities, axes, intervals, or algebraic objects needed to reach this conclusion: The domain requires x≥1. Squaring gives candidates 0 and 3; only x=3 checks.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Classify and solve common equation and inequality families while distinguishing reversible steps from candidate-generating steps.

manifests.title: Equivalence versus implication ledger
manifests.description: Visualize the mechanism explicitly: Classify the family, state restrictions, use reversible steps when possible, label candidate-generating steps such as squaring or denominator clearing, and check candidates in the original statement. The figure must show intermediate states or mappings, not merely the final formula.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Classify and solve common equation and inequality families while distinguishing reversible steps from candidate-generating steps.

manifests.title: Negative scaling reflection
manifests.description: Place the correct structure beside the invalid move described here: A frequent error is reporting every algebraic candidate as a solution without checking the original equation. Mark the first point where the conclusions diverge.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Classify and solve common equation and inequality families while distinguishing reversible steps from candidate-generating steps.

manifests.title: Factoring decision sequence
manifests.description: Depict the foundation problem exactly: Factor x^4-5x^2+4. Show the quantities, axes, intervals, or algebraic objects needed to reach this conclusion: Let u=x^2. Then (u-1)(u-4), so (x-1)(x+1)(x-2)(x+2).
manifests.learnerOutcome: Recognize and apply the principal factoring structures needed for polynomial-function analysis.

manifests.title: Trinomial product grid
manifests.description: Visualize the mechanism explicitly: Extract a greatest common factor first, recognize grouping or special-product structure, factor each result again, and verify by multiplication. The figure must show intermediate states or mappings, not merely the final formula.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Recognize and apply the principal factoring structures needed for polynomial-function analysis.

manifests.title: Factor-to-zero preview
manifests.description: Place the correct structure beside the invalid move described here: A frequent error is stopping after one factorization step or cancelling terms that are not common factors. Mark the first point where the conclusions diverge.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Recognize and apply the principal factoring structures needed for polynomial-function analysis.

manifests.title: Legal versus illegal cancellation
manifests.description: Depict the foundation problem exactly: Simplify (x^2+x-6)/(x^2-4). Show the quantities, axes, intervals, or algebraic objects needed to reach this conclusion: The result is (x+3)/(x+2), with x≠2,-2.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Simplify and solve rational expressions while preserving every restriction from the original form.

manifests.title: Original-domain overlay
manifests.description: Visualize the mechanism explicitly: Record restrictions, factor completely, cancel only common factors, combine over a least common denominator, and check equation candidates against the original domain. The figure must show intermediate states or mappings, not merely the final formula.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Simplify and solve rational expressions while preserving every restriction from the original form.

manifests.title: Candidate filter

manifests.learnerOutcome: Simplify and solve rational expressions while preserving every restriction from the original form.

manifests.title: Principal root versus equation roots
manifests.description: Depict the foundation problem exactly: Solve sqrt(x+6)=x. Show the quantities, axes, intervals, or algebraic objects needed to reach this conclusion: Candidates are 3 and -2; only x=3 satisfies the original equation.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Move among radical and rational-exponent forms, simplify exact values, and reject extraneous candidates.

manifests.title: Radical-exponent equivalence
manifests.description: Visualize the mechanism explicitly: Extract perfect powers, convert between radical and rational-exponent notation, isolate a radical in an equation, raise both sides to a power, and check every candidate. The figure must show intermediate states or mappings, not merely the final formula.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Move among radical and rational-exponent forms, simplify exact values, and reject extraneous candidates.

manifests.title: Extraneous-solution map

manifests.learnerOutcome: Move among radical and rational-exponent forms, simplify exact values, and reject extraneous candidates.

manifests.title: Exponent-law derivation
manifests.description: Depict the foundation problem exactly: Evaluate log_3(1/27). Show the quantities, axes, intervals, or algebraic objects needed to reach this conclusion: -3, because 3^(-3)=1/27.
manifests.learnerOutcome: Apply exponent and logarithm laws, convert between inverse forms, and solve basic equations with valid domains.

manifests.title: Exponential-log inverse pair

manifests.learnerOutcome: Apply exponent and logarithm laws, convert between inverse forms, and solve basic equations with valid domains.

manifests.title: False sum-law counterexamples
